title: Fitriana Wibowo - Key to Managing Team & Making Work More Fun | Bukatalks
description: A fun job is a job where we have a team leader that can build motivation and embrace the whole team so that work can be more fun.   In the Press for Progress Edition Bukatalks, Women in Tech Startup, Fitriana Wibowo (Senior Product Manager of Bukalapak) will share stories how to respect the work of team members and make it more productive.  Come on, watch the bukatalks video right now!  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Subscribe: http://bl.id/subs-bukalapak  Bukatalks Women in Tech Startup: https://www.youtube.com/playlist  Other #bukatalks videos: https://www.youtube.com/watch  Website: https://www.bukalapak.com/  Download the Bukalapak application here iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/id/app/bukalapak-jual-beli-online/id1003169137?l=id  Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bukalapak.android   Like / follow social media bukalapak: Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/bukalapak Twitter - https://www.twitter.com/bukalapak Instagram - https://instagram.com/bukalapak Google Plus - https://plus.google.com/+bukalapakdotcom Community Forum - https://komunitas.bukalapak.com Stack Overflow - https://stackoverflow.com/jobs/companies/bukalapak LinkedIn-https://www.linkedin.com/company/pt-bukalapak-com

Let's stay the same to inspire to others, ok? Before the introduction, I'm Fitriana Purnama Sarwibowo. A lot of your fans, actually. Now I'm a Product Manager at Bukalapak Let's continue Why is the topic managing happy and productive team? We're connected from your introduction As a product manager, I think I usually focus to maintaining my products, maintaining my metrics but actually in the same time, I realized that I, to manage your team well for your products From the outline I will share these 4 points We will talk about how to motivate our team We will also talk about how we manage performance of our team Later, we'll talk about developing team talent and also about how to make the team's work fun There are actually many ways, we as product managers or as leader or lead, we motivate our team The most important was important thing We need a goal between the team and the leader So, we need to set a goal for our team To be accurate because our team can easily be measurable and align We want our team to be productive. There are lots of product and features. But we're also demanded to manage their quality We're talking about content versus quality, which is usually mutual supportive this is Quantitative vs Quality and that is a usually unsupportive quality because most of the tasks needs to be delivered in a fast way the quality can't be as maximum as possible and also reachable that means, motivation can be challenging for team, if the team clear in reaching the goals, and can be delivered in certain time Next, you have to identify and measure the goal. as we've described, what you have to have to measure with? You also need to define the break down into smaller goals in products usually, we have a target to quarterly, we need a break down to monthly, maybe to weekly another way to motivate a team also on track performance tracking performance, most likely, product managers monitors the metrics individually they rarely share it to their team, there need to be transparency between the product manager and the team so, as much as possible the product's of the product is known to an average of people in this team So, they know what is the impact of outcome tool delivered to the market and how big impact they will put on our KPI accomplishment It's like our values, the goals we set Or it could be through rewards and recognition For rewards or recognition it is more, you know a formal way of using it Just like a bonus but for rewarding, it is more you know, you can be more formal You can deliver something and say thank you. to say , as simple as that and one is good at creating the job performance and delivery and also to preserve the relationship and work environment so between the one team, you must be positive, support, and respect each other So the people in the team don't interfere in collaboration or cooperation Lastly, accountability. It's more like when you set goal, you have to be able to evaluate for a product manager each other, and the case of we have motivated them Then we also need to tracking them, or if the motivation that we do must have out of result to the team There have 3 ways, we evaluate the performance for each member there are many evaluation on individual there are appraisal what usually done with certain time and there are Personal notes so usually each PM monitor personal development in their team what their advantage? what need to improved? there are also one-on-one sessions one-on-one is personally monitoring what are the advantages of this person? What does need improve? You can also do 1 on 1 sessions, to monitor in a personal way Try to deal with the trouble at 1 on 1 sessions You can experience different difficulties in the working environment or outside the working environment But the task for us as a product manager is one of them found solution, helping in looking for solution at least, when we can't find the solution, we can be their good hearing Next Next, about retrospecif Usually, in have team evaluation for our team performance what's our delivery rate, what are the do, and what are his or her needs to be improved and what are his or her interests in what area, for instance, when we talk about software engineers are more interested in management we talk about that later how steps the engineer wanting to change to product management How people understand how to move forward with confidence and clarity For example if the team finds something difficult in the end, we should be careful to find the solution in order to finish some work There are a lot of ways we can do it, like individual development program, HCM cooperation, training, workshop, certification, it can improve their soft skills and hard skills Then dealing with underperforming team member If you are a product manager, it means not all staff can perform Most of the friends that we will see is personal, and they cannot perform It should be at least 1-3 underperformal people which is something we, as a Product Manager, cannot see the output that people get, such as them working on their products for too long in one side, we must know the reason why our friends aren't performing or had specific personal problems Maybe their desire for problem solving is still in need of direction either the problem's got solved, that they still had to be guided or the problem we usually solved from the product managers are not clear So they do not know the solution, where the issue came from. So there are lots of things The thing we need to guide that. For example, there's a few of them, Like Ma'am, to be frank, actually I have a monotonous business and I got bored of my work, I'm tired of my work, I'll just start working in different tasks It's hard work, they don't have time to develop their personal development in the team so, they have offered to move to a squatline team. And that's important for their personal development I will demonstrate how to develop personal nodes As Product Manager, we'd be able to maintain the personal team It's so easy, we would just need to make a summary The other way, the product manager can control his personal team There are various, so just use sampling We can do lot, such as the grading of personal skills, in the delivery of item quality, etc Each person should have the right to value as range We can use these 3 ways, first one is how to delegate Actually sometimes these delegation are misused. Sometimes they are misused as time management tool. But these delegation are not form of tne management tool, you can add more to the personal tool called per-people development tool To delegate this, you need to be careful about it we must know whether the task can be deliver by the person Are the person capable to finish the task? because as product manager, we need to do the briefings first. To do a followup on this matter, so this delegation can't blame the initial goal Second one, coaching and mentoring In Bukalapak, usually the product manager works with the engineering manager They usually have coaching from the team members to the product manager Coaching is more towards short term goals Which means, what's the right position for him now? what would be the goal of the engineer? For example, based on engineer's goals when working in that squad What he gotta develop? What skill he should develop in that squad Those are more concerning to product manager But long term Goals could be more to engineering and manager Because those require more discussion So, earlier, one of the samples that it's a great opportunity for us as the engineering team to try to be a part of the products To be able to have step by step mentoring is for the coaching team Next is managing high potential Then, Managing High Potential Before talking about underperforming people, it doesn't mean someone in a team will have high potential It means he is able to properly solve the team's responsibility He be able to deliver all the task on time There are people like those you can use as their mentor or coaching So, you need to work with these type of people to help each need to find the problem in their daily lives Next, When you talk about work, but we should avoid all those issues Work-life balance is the most common Our challenge is to make sure that our team enjoys their work Very fun for them to enjoy That's why, there are many ways to make your team comfortable, make your team happy In one of those is after we finished the group work Celebrating with a performance, or just go out And then create positive work environment In my team we have one habit First if we eat together in afternoon time, and we don't really talk about it, but my fellow engineer give feedback why the conversation only enjoy when having dinner? and then go out, their problem solving and no question is asked what's their issue, in their working place, there is more pressure and also using team member live event to build friendship any sort of issue, and it can be shared or not we want the people who are working in the work place to share and also from outside, if there are issues or it in the same way, we can create one solution That's all
